scope: Real Detectron2 OVRSTrainer, real OVRSIS95K train examples; two FP32 optimizer steps per M/V/R. Two-image dev only for software smoke, never formal performance.

optimizer.note: Channel audit: M gate nonzero/mix zero as designed, V and R gate/mix nonzero; same-rival relation input gradient zero in M/V and nonzero in R. Output pair bias has near-zero gradient, consistent with a common softmax-logit shift.

resume: 10-step schedule interrupted immediately after checkpoint at iteration 1, resumed at iteration 2; two additional updates with nonzero parameter changes and checkpoint at iteration 3. Intentional AUDIT_STOP_AFTER_CHECKPOINT exceptions in logs.
eval_only: V checkpoint evaluated twice on two source-dev images with the same output root; separate run directories and per_image.jsonl files were created.
limitations: No AMP test; historical and current selected training protocol is FP32.
Full 4700-image arm comparison was not established by this smoke.
Temporary server files are volatile; portable small logs copied locally.
